comparison_contract.input_length: L is the full common input encoding length
comparison_contract.generic_opponent: same public semantics, actions, approvals, budgets, representation and requested output; existing general preprocessing allowed
comparison_contract.asymptotic_scope: unbounded theoretical families, separate from finite W0

input_family.actions: approved atomic rebind of one task to a different pre-existing root, then independent root revocations
input_family.migration_count: exactly one per realized first request
input_family.G_accounting: all allocated initial independent roots count, including subsequently revoked or emptied roots

claims.generic_method: complete dynamic partition/CSP search with ordinary certificate checking and a two-block lower bound
claims.metric: worst-case solver work on identical explicit inputs
claims.killer: The generic opponent has the same dynamic plans and G. On this family a zero-signature anchor partition plus rowwise certificate checking closes optimality in O(L). Static versus dynamic G compares different action spaces.
claims.evidence_level: 已证定理，明确模型内完整人工证明
claims.reopening_condition: A new same-interface computational lower bound against a specified general algorithm class, with the simple certificate construction included in the comparator

claims.input_family: n disjoint AT/RT pairs with explicit native revocation effects and preservation constraints

coordinates: a = AT active for issuing introspector
r = RT active for same introspector
minimal_instance.observation_scope: fresh password grant, configured confidential client, immediate introspection; RT refresh usability requires separate witness

claims.generic_method: safe-effect filtering plus union coverage; budgeted extension is standard Set Cover/CSP
claims.metric: decision work on the full same effect matrix
claims.killer: Unbudgeted fixed monotone effects have the same linear safe-union test. Budgeted selection contains Set Cover, and partial stop/preserve grouping contains graph coloring under stated assumptions.
evidence_levels: 已证定理，固定单调效果模型
实测数据，52条历史观察的受限profile
claims.reopening_condition: State-changing effect semantics and a proven separation beyond safe coverage/CSP, motivated by the observed credential-birth race

claims.input_family: n fully observed independent cleanup chains, unit costs, fixed completed base goal, all cleanup permissions present
claims.generic_method: resource counting, symbolic threshold representation and DAG dynamic programming; Set Cover for shared cleanup
claims.metric: membership in W with identical output requirements
claims.killer: General counting obtains sum(d_i) <= min(b,r). Exponential explicit W output is a different output task. Exponential cleanup trees impose the same physical work on every method.
claims.evidence_level: 已证定理及构造性纸面反例，限定模型
claims.reopening_condition: A fixed partially observable obligation model and a same-output parameterized lower bound not explained by generic resource DP or Set Cover

claims.input_family: N black-box platforms with independent hidden AT-revoke cascade bits and otherwise identical public discovery metadata

minimal_instance.scope: theoretical oracle construction; measured native deployments retain their distinct actual metadata

claims.generic_method: one platform-specific measurement per independent bit
claims.killer: An unqueried platform can flip its bit without altering the observed transcript. Every exact method requires at least N observations, and N suffice in the declared oracle model.
evidence_levels: 已证定理，黑盒查询模型
实测数据，历史调查二次分析
claims.reopening_condition: An independently attested cross-platform relation that actually constrains the hidden bits, supplied equally to every method

retained_theorems.statement: For a fixed partition and nontrivial S, at-most-one rebind feasibility iff the minimum block-label disagreement is <= 1
For k>=2 and a nontrivial requirement, dynamic G>=2. For every k>=3 a family with static G=k and dynamic G=2 attains saving k-2 using exactly one rebind per request
All nonempty proper stop subsets of k-1 ordinary tasks with one retained anchor have static G=k and one-rebind dynamic G=k-1
Fixed effect blocks must refine the termination-signature partition
Fixed monotone deletion with unlimited budget is feasible iff safe effects cover every required deletion
Independent known chains satisfy sum(d_i)<=min(b,r); W size follows the bounded composition generating function
Probe creation rate rho costs q(1+rho) in both budget and steps, with q<=floor(min(B,H)/(1+rho)); c-ary cleanup depth d requires sum_{j=0}^d c^j actions per root
Budgeted shared cleanup is NP-complete in the declared depth-one deterministic model via Set Cover
An exact full vector of N independent black-box behavior bits requires N observations
